name: fabric-gates
description: Hooks that keep an agent inside a review-first git workflow: draft-first PRs, merge only the reviewed head, branch prefix, and edits to the enforcement layer only with a human unlock.

branch_prefix.title: Branch prefix
branch_prefix.description: Every branch the agent creates must start with this, for example me/. Branch creation is blocked until it is set.

protected_paths.title: Extra protected paths
protected_paths.description: Comma-separated paths relative to your home directory that agents may not edit without an unlock, for example notes/review-rubric, standards/review.md.

gate_unlock_minutes.title: Unlock window (minutes)
gate_unlock_minutes.description: How long `touch ~/.claude/gate-unlock` allows edits to protected paths. Clamped to 1-60.
